pov: 第一人称（Tris 叙述，用“I”），主干过去时，夹杂现在时短句（如“I can’t feel my fingers.”）

facts.event: 父亲 Andrew 走到 Tris 面前、双手按住她的肩膀；她被碰到臂上伤口而吸气，但让她退开的不是疼痛，而是那双手的重量——她已经太沉，这份重量让她受不了。
facts.text: My father steps in front of me, and sets his hands on my shoulders. I hiss as he makes contact with the wound in my arm, but the pain isn’t what makes me pull away from him; it’s the weight. The weight of his hands, dragging me down when I’m already so heavy, is unbearable.

facts.event: Tris 觉得父亲的提问（也许还有答案）里藏着危险：说出口就会让母亲之死变成真的，可她不得不说，因为她一个人扛不住。
facts.text: There’s something dangerous in the question. Or maybe in the answer. I can’t tell him what happened, because that will make it real. But I have to tell him what happened, because I can’t carry it alone.

facts.event: Tobias 检查伤口后说子弹从她手臂直穿过去，站起来拍了拍她的肩膀，指出出口伤在哪里。
facts.text: “I think the bullet went right through you,” he says. He stands, tapping my shoulder. “There’s the exit wound.”

facts.event: Marcus Eaton 站在一旁，递出一团布——那是他的衬衫（他外面仍穿灰外套、里面还有内衣），他脱掉了中间那一层。
facts.text: I look up to see Marcus Eaton standing off to the side, holding out a bundle of fabric. It’s his shirt—he still has an undershirt on, with his gray jacket over it, but he must have taken off his middle layer.

facts.event: 远处又传来一声枪响；Tris 想到躺在床上、手臂伸直的 Abigail Baker，以及二十五名议员——在被模拟控制的无畏派追杀下，还有几个活着、几个能活下去。
facts.text: I hear, off in the distance, another gunshot. I think of Abigail Baker, lying on the bed, her arm outstretched. There are twenty-five council members. How many of them are still alive? How many of them will stay alive, with simulation-bound Dauntless hunting them down?

facts.event: Tris 说必须去无畏派总部：如果模拟只影响无畏派新生，那源头一定在那里。
facts.text: “No, I mean . . . we need to go to Dauntless headquarters,” I say. “That’s where the simulation must be coming from, if it’s affecting only Dauntless initiates.”

facts.event: Tris 与 Tobias 从楼顶跃下后被网接住，紧绷的纤维裹住两人又摊平；她手臂作痛，憋出一声笑。
facts.text: Then the net swallows us both, wrapping around us with taut, hard fibers and then flattening. My arm aches. I let out a strangled laugh.

facts.event: Tris 注意到 Caleb 脱下外套，从外套下的枪套里拔出一把枪。
facts.text: And then I notice Caleb taking off his jacket, and drawing a gun that’s holstered beneath it.

relations: Tris 与 Andrew 是父女：她称他“my father”，他为她愿意开枪（“If my daughter is at risk”）。
Tobias 与 Marcus Eaton 是父子：Tobias 走过屋顶时“像在假装 Marcus 不存在”，Tris 也照做。
Caleb 与 Tris 是兄妹：章末 Caleb 拔枪指向 Tobias 后脑，完成背叛。
Caleb 与 Jeanine Matthews 关系亲近：他直呼“Jeanine”，Tris 与父亲都注意到（不是“Ms. Matthews”）。
Tobias 是 Tris 最信任的人：教堂里替她查看伤口、撕衬衫包扎，她认为只有他真正懂她。
Marcus 与 Evelyn 曾联手（Tris 推断 Evelyn 拿 Marcus 换武器与运输），Hemlock 参与其中。
Tris 与 Tobias 是恋人：她伸手要他牵、说“See you at the bottom”，落地后他扶住她的腰与颈侧。
numbers: twenty-five council members（议员共 25 名）
another hour（大约再过一小时才会有人知道 Abnegation 出了事）
